question: How can even a wise person be affected while approaching the tip of nectar?
premises: The tip of nectar is involved
The essence of juice is present
Even a wise person may burn
inference: Even a wise person may experience burning when engaging the tip of nectar with its essence.
uncertainties: The precise yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ is unclear.
plain_english: Even a wise person may burn at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
